housing: Richmond renters often live in old row houses split into apartments, especially near VCU, plus rented houses and new apartment buildings.
climate: Test the air conditioning and look for damp and leaks in old row houses; summers are hot and humid.
fact: Many Fan District row houses near VCU are split into student apartments.
